en.title: Ask a question. Follow the evidence.
en.subtitle: VMware Skills · AI-assisted infrastructure operations
en.speech: What needs attention in your VMware environment? VMware Skills connects an AI assistant to focused skills and MCP tools, helping engineers investigate infrastructure and plan their next steps.

en.title: One family. Focused responsibilities.
en.subtitle: 15 skills · 14 MCP servers · shared Policy library
en.speech: The family covers vSphere, networking, storage, observability and more. Pilot coordinates workflows. Domain servers connect to their management systems. Policy provides shared checks, sanitization and audit logging. Start with the read-only Monitor.

en.title: From a question to real inventory.
en.subtitle: Historical screenshot excerpt · original English output
en.speech: Here is a historical screenshot from an actual session. The inventory view returned one vCenter, two standalone hosts, and thirteen VMs. The notes column containing environment identifiers is omitted. These are recorded results, not a fresh inventory of the environment.

en.title: Health with context, not guesswork.
en.subtitle: Captured observations · verify timing and scope
en.speech: The health screenshot records connected hosts and critical alarms in the same view. That does not establish a current incident. Check when the observation was captured and whether the alarms still apply before deciding what to investigate next.

en.title: Plan changes with explicit boundaries.
en.subtitle: Assess → review → execute → verify
en.speech: When changes are needed, use the relevant domain skill and a reviewed workflow. Existing VMware permissions and local policy still apply. Destructive tools use preview and confirmation gates. A confirmation flag is not independent human approval, and rollback is best effort.

en.title: Finish with a traceable audit trail.
en.subtitle: Historical export summary · target identifiers omitted
en.speech: Finally, follow the audit trail. This is an assistant-prepared summary of exported records, showing time, skill, tool, MCP or CLI, status and duration. We omit the target column and show fourteen rows. Names reflect the captured version; use the original records to check completeness.

en.title: Make everyday operations a little easier.
en.subtitle: Explore · try a read-only task · share feedback
en.speech: VMware Skills is a community open-source project, not an official VMware or Broadcom product. Explore the demos, try a read-only task, and share what works or what needs improvement. If it helps your work, star the family portal to help others find it.

zh.title: 问一个问题，沿着证据调查。
zh.subtitle: VMware Skills · AI 辅助基础设施运维
zh.speech: 你的 VMware 环境，现在最需要关注什么？VMware Skills 把人工智能助手与专业技能和 MCP 工具连接起来，帮助工程师调查基础设施，找到下一步。

zh.title: 一个家族，明确分工。
zh.subtitle: 15 个 skill · 14 个 MCP server · 共享 Policy 库
zh.speech: 整个家族覆盖计算、网络、存储和可观测性。Pilot 编排工作流，领域服务连接各自的管理系统，Policy 提供共享策略检查、文本清洗和审计。建议从只读 Monitor 开始。

zh.title: 问一句，看到实际调用返回的清单。
zh.subtitle: 历史截图节选 · 保留原始英文界面
zh.speech: 这里是实际调用的历史截图。清单返回了一个 vCenter、两台独立主机和十三台虚拟机。包含环境标识的备注列已经裁去。它展示当时查询范围内的结果，不是对当前环境重新做的一次清查。

zh.title: 看健康，也保留判断边界。
zh.subtitle: 历史观测 · 核对时间与查询范围
zh.speech: 健康截图把主机连接状态和严重告警放在同一个视图里。但历史状态不等于当前正在发生故障。决定下一步前，仍要核对观测时间，以及告警现在是否依然成立。

zh.title: 需要变更时，先明确边界。
zh.subtitle: 评估 → 复核 → 执行 → 验证
zh.speech: 需要变更时，再选择对应领域技能和经过复核的工作流。VMware 原有权限与本地策略继续生效。破坏性工具有预览和确认门，但确认参数并不等于独立人工审批，回滚也只能尽力执行。

zh.title: 最后，用审计记录追溯调用。
zh.subtitle: 历史导出汇总 · 已省略目标标识
zh.speech: 最后看审计记录。这是基于导出记录整理的助手汇总，列出时间、技能、工具、MCP 或 CLI 路径、状态和耗时。演示省略目标列，节选十四行。工具名称保留截图当时版本；完整性仍需核对原始记录。

zh.title: 让日常运维，轻松一点。
zh.subtitle: 了解项目 · 试一个只读任务 · 分享反馈
zh.speech: VMware Skills 是社区开源项目，并非 VMware 或 Broadcom 官方产品。欢迎查看演示，试一个只读任务，分享有效的经验与需要改进的地方。如果它对你有用，也欢迎为家族门户点一颗星。
